status: All three fixed first probes rejected as replacements; no live integration, threshold sweep or held-out scoring.
method: Five original full-mix excerpts plus continuous full Late Night and Midnight Patience masters, scoring four fixed master passages. 130 scored provisional visual kick labels; uncertain audio excluded. Actual unshifted sample availability, no lookahead. All seven baseline Python event lists exactly reproduce frozen native Rust output. Source stems only for controlled diagnosis, not reconstruction or master-label accuracy.

settings.temporal: 20ms trailing predicate evidence, current absolute floor, consume evidence when candidate starts; original confirmation, timeout and refractory unchanged.
settings.tonal: Trailing 2048-sample-at-48k Hann spectra, 24 log target bands/octave quantized to unique native FFT bins in 30-2000Hz; adjacent-centre overlapping triangles. Positive difference versus two hops earlier. Three-band maximum filter. Pass confirmation if last 20ms SuperFlux/ordinary flux >=0.35 and ordinary flux >1e-8. Other v5 decisions unchanged. Fixed-size FFT batches are computation only, not future evidence.
settings.pcen: Three existing fast band-power envelopes; zero-initialized causal 0.4s EMA, epsilon=1e-6, alpha=.98, delta=2, exponent=.5. Positive low/body change over two hops; candidate>=.10, rearm<.05, original absolute floor/body-balance and confirmation retained. No temporal or tonal branch combined.

interpretations: Temporal evidence increases recall but joins ongoing bass fluctuations into many extra events.
Tonal mask removes both master bass-passage false fires but also rejects strong visually supported kicks; not a safe universal veto.
PCEN on current 3ms power envelopes fires on a stationary harmonic signal. Fix the input representation before interpreting this as evidence against PCEN generally.

evidence_review.observation: Both temporal and PCEN recover a reference-associated event within 70ms; existing detailed master/source waveform sheet shows a soft kick renewal. Labels unchanged.
PCEN recovers a reference-associated event within 70ms; existing panel 18 shows a renewed source attack and corresponding master change. Timing remains an interval.
Tonal mask loses this reference even at 70ms. Existing panel 19 shows a strong source/master attack; no evidence to relabel it away.

runtime.interpretation: Single-run process CPU time divided by audio duration, including causal feature extraction and detector, excluding decode/scoring/reference replay. Python batch throughput only: no native callback, allocation, scheduling, worst-case deadline or end-to-end app guarantee. No GPU used.
